name: Standard Sales Order Processing Path
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with valid Sales Order notification (giic_OrderTypeCode__c = 'YORB')
expected_outcome: Message is enriched with metadata properties and headers, evaluates to Glovia_Route_SalesOrder, executes Test_Mapping message mapping, applies generic headers, and completes successfully at EndEvent_2
validates: CallActivity_4 (Content Modifier), ParallelGateway_74, ExclusiveGateway_80 (SalesOrder route), CallActivity_102 (Message Mapping 1), CallActivity_13 (Generic Headers), EndEvent_2

name: Sales Order Return Processing Path
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with Return Sales Order notification (giic_OrderTypeCode__c = 'POR')
expected_outcome: Message is enriched, evaluates Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder condition, skips mapping, invokes CallActivity_71 for custom header logging, and terminates successfully at EndEvent_9
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 (SO Return create route), CallActivity_71 (Generic Headers), EndEvent_9

name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation Path
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with unknown or unconfigured OrderTypeCode (e.g., 'UNKNOWN_TYPE')
expected_outcome: Router default branch SequenceFlow_110 is selected, terminating at EndEvent_11 with escalation code RoutingConditionNotMet
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default path (SequenceFlow_110), EndEvent_11 (EscalationEndEvent with ErrorCode RoutingConditionNotMet)

name: Mapping Failure Triggers Exception Subprocess
trigger: Inbound SOAP message triggering Sales Order route with corrupted data causing Test_Mapping runtime failure
expected_outcome: Exception caught by StartEvent_92, CallActivity_97 restores original body from property.InputPayload, CallActivity_100 logs raw payload, and flow terminates with ErrorEndEvent
validates: SubProcess_91, StartEvent_92, CallActivity_97 (Property Enricher), CallActivity_100 (Log Payload Script), EndEvent_95

name: SOAP Adapter Security / Authorization Failure
trigger: Inbound SOAP HTTP request missing required ESBMessaging.send role credentials or invalid signature
expected_outcome: Inbound adapter rejects message with HTTP 401/403 before integration process starts
validates: MessageFlow_114 inbound security configuration and userRole enforcement

name: Boundary Payload Size Validation
trigger: Inbound SOAP request exceeding maximumBodySize limit of 40MB configured on SOAP sender channel
expected_outcome: SOAP CXF runtime raises payload size limit exception, rejecting execution at adapter level
